headline: OpenAI makes the Decisions API generally available for bounded classification, routing and scoring
summary: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available on Oct 22, 2026. The dedicated endpoint turns text, image and JSON inputs into bounded probabilities, choices or scores, currently using GPT-6 Luna; the API guide allows up to 400 questions per request and documents prompt caching and native GPT-Live integration. Decisions and standard GPT-6 Luna uncached input are both listed at $0.10 per million tokens; this endpoint has no output-token charge, while caching discounts and regional/long-context terms also affect cost. OpenAI claims up to 10× lower latency than GPT-6 Luna through Responses API but publishes no workload protocol in the reviewed launch materials. Independent performance, adoption and realized economic effects remain unestablished.
